record.paper_title: Some of my favorite open problems
record.context_brief: asymptotic radial symmetry for p-Ginzburg-Landau minimizers and critical points
record.original_question: For p > 2, let Omega be the unit disc in R^2 with boundary value g(x)=x, and define the p-Ginzburg-Landau energy E_{epsilon,p}(u) = (1/p) integral_Omega |grad u|^p + (1/(4 epsilon^2)) integral_Omega (|u|^2 - 1)^2 on W^{1,p}_g(Omega; R^2). If u_epsilon is any minimizer, or more generally any critical point, of E_{epsilon,p}, must u_epsilon(x) converge to x/|x| on Omega without the origin as epsilon -> 0?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 2.3 ([26, Open Problem 30]). Assume p > 2 and let u_epsilon be any minimizer (resp., critical point) of E_{epsilon,p}. Does u_epsilon(x) -> x/|x| in Omega without {0} as epsilon -> 0?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^2$ be the open unit disc, and fix $p > 2$. For $\varepsilon > 0$, consider the $p$-Ginzburg–Landau energy
$$E_{\varepsilon,p}(u) = \frac{1}{p}\int_\Omega |\nabla u|^p\,dx + \frac{1}{4\varepsilon^2}\int_\Omega (|u|^2 - 1)^2\,dx$$
defined on the affine Sobolev space $W^{1,p}_g(\Omega;\mathbb{R}^2) = \{ u \in W^{1,p}(\Omega;\mathbb{R}^2) : u|_{\partial\Omega} = g \}$, where $g(x) = x$ for $x \in \partial\Omega$.

Let $u_\varepsilon \in W^{1,p}_g(\Omega;\mathbb{R}^2)$ be any minimizer of $E_{\varepsilon,p}$, or more generally any critical point of $E_{\varepsilon,p}$. Determine whether
$$u_\varepsilon(x) \longrightarrow \frac{x}{|x|} \qquad \text{as } \varepsilon \to 0$$
on $\Omega \setminus \{0\}$ (e.g., locally uniformly, or in an appropriate Sobolev sense on compact subsets of $\Omega \setminus \{0\}$).
artifact.status_search_result: The asymptotic radial-symmetry question for minimizers and critical points of the $p$-Ginzburg–Landau functional ($p>2$) on the disc with boundary datum $x$ has been investigated in several works on $p$-energy and Ginzburg–Landau-type asymptotics, but no definitive resolution for all critical points (or even all minimizers) was located. Available results address partial cases (convergence in $W^{1,p}$, $C^{1,\alpha}$ convergence away from singular sets, weighted versions, higher dimensions), without confirming or refuting the full conjectured convergence $u_\varepsilon(x)\to x/|x|$ on $\Omega\setminus\{0\}$ for arbitrary critical points.

status_evidence.title: Asymptotic behavior for minimizers of a Ginzburg–Landau-type functional in higher dimensions
status_evidence.snippet: Studies asymptotic behavior of p-Ginzburg–Landau minimizers, establishing partial convergence results.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results on asymptotic convergence of p-Ginzburg–Landau minimizers exist.

status_evidence.title: C^{1,α} convergence of a Ginzburg–Landau type minimizer in higher dimensions
status_evidence.snippet: Proves C^{1,α} convergence of minimizers of p-Ginzburg–Landau-type functionals away from singular set.
status_evidence.claim: Convergence is known away from singular set for minimizers, but the general critical-point case is not addressed.

status_evidence.title: Limiting behavior of minimizers of p(x)-Ginzburg–Landau type
status_evidence.snippet: Studies limiting behavior of minimizers for variable-exponent p-Ginzburg–Landau functionals.
status_evidence.claim: Related variants studied; the precise question for critical points remains unsettled in the located literature.
